title: Joe Sondow - Twitter and Procedural Generation
speaker: Joe Sondow
description:
Joe Sondow talks about his twitter bots and his creative limits with procedural generation.
This video is from the 2017 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event2017.html
